Drosophila Schneider cells express Gal4-VP16 and a UAS-Photinus luciferase reporter. A62 SID24841422/CID16196968 is Inconclusive with Single point of activity; its nominal deposited Potency 35.4813 μM remains an unreliable single-point fit. The paired AID2551 row is Active but has a Partial curve; high efficacy and does not by itself establish ROR-gamma target selectivity. Protocol: 600 cells per well, 1 h compound preincubation, 700 μM copper sulfate induction, 20 h incubation and luciferase detection after 10 min. The mouse ROR-gamma accession in the AID2546 metadata is contextual indexing; it is not the protein assayed in this VP16 counterscreen and is not assigned as the tested construct. The original ROR-gamma candidate label remains restricted, with both original assay records preserved. No positive isolated-protein potency,selectivity or direct binding is restored.

protein_metadata_review.note: PrimaryTable1 reports competitive-inhibition Ki>50,000nM for paxilline18 againstHuman OSBP. The footnote states that a greater-than range means competition seen at some high concentrations but insufficient points for a fittedKi curve. It is not a precisely measured50,000nM Ki or high-affinity target. This radioligand competition in cell lysate is not an SPR KD or a purified-protein binding constant. Paxilline is chemically distinct from the oxysterol series; no unrelated potent sterol values are copied. Supplied SI PDFpp10-11 now confirms human OSBP or ORP4L constructs expressed in HEK293T and the clarified binding-lysate preparation. The SI refers the detailed competition procedure to Burgett et al.; no ligand concentration, assay incubation time or temperature is invented. The reported greater-than Ki bounds and non-fitted interpretation remain unchanged.
